title: The LLM sets: M4 by stage from every kept exchange and Home conversation, M5 from every Claude Code and intern session, sealed people and benchmarks kept out
request: M4 chat examples by stage and M5 whole trajectories, with reasoning, decontaminated against sealed sets and MLE-bench.
plan: M4 from exchanges kept whole and drafts' conversations.
M5 from transcripts and intern sessions.
Keep out sealed people's words and benchmark tasks.

decisions.decision: Contamination is matched on an example's own texts with one compiled pattern.
decisions.why: Matching on JSON missed sentences with quotes or line breaks, and 1,300 substring searches per example were slow.

decisions.decision: Trajectories are built transcript by transcript.
decisions.why: 1.1 GB of transcripts must never be held at once.

change: dclab_rnd.store.sets.llm (from_exchange, from_draft, trajectories, intern_trajectories, Contamination, sealed_texts), benchmarks.txt (MLE-bench Lite, to be checked).

findings.defect: The LLM builders bypassed consent and the curators.
findings.scenario: A tester's exchange refused by the guarded write still reached M4.
findings.cause: The builders did not read the curators' refusals.
findings.fix: Every builder takes only train-consented records that no curator refused or kept out.

findings.defect: Each exchange was split by its own request.
findings.scenario: A conversation's turns repeat earlier turns: they could sit in train and sealed.
findings.cause: No group was given to exchanges.
findings.fix: Every record's split is its project's group.

findings.defect: The newest draft was chosen by the id's text.
The benchmark list was empty and intern sessions were not built.
findings.scenario: No MLE-bench task could be caught.
findings.cause: The list was left to fill.
findings.fix: MLE-bench Lite listed (to check against its source); intern trajectories built.

findings.defect: The benchmark list was read once at import.
findings.scenario: A test's own list was never used.
findings.cause: A default argument bound at definition.

findings.defect: The benchmark list was written from memory.
findings.scenario: A competition of MLE-bench missing from the list would let its solutions into train.
findings.cause: Only the Lite split was remembered.
findings.fix: Checked against openai/mle-bench's split files: Lite matched 22 of 22; the 75 competitions and spaceship-titanic added.

outcome: The workflow LLM and the solver LLM have their sets, every turn and step with its labelled reasoning, nothing sealed or benchmarked in train.
lessons: A default argument is read once: anything a test or a caller should change is read at call time.
